purpose: Exploratory matched reference-maintenance slice; not sealed full-workload acceptance
verificationPolicy: Focused feedback during implementation and repairs; independent semantic/scope review, then a fresh unchanged scripts/conformance-ci.sh and evaluator checks on the immutable committed candidate. Relevant later edits invalidate verification.

acceptanceChecks: Audit all 275 reference allocations, including existing but nongoverning umbrella anchors
Reject invalid current refs before any authoring output creation, deletion or change
Preserve case IDs and non-reference allocations, fixed certified builder, private identity and complete-catalog/duplicate checks
Preserve valid cross-family dependency references and existing reference cardinality
Valid current authoring completes; frozen snapshot and independent conformance unchanged
Independent governing-semantic/scope review, evaluator checks and unchanged full gate pass

contract.authority: Supplied live specification family and normative artifacts; derived context is not authority
contract.preservation: Only spec_refs may change in catalog; validation may be added without changing valid behavior or adding production test seams
contract.uncertainty: Existing anchors can be semantically wrong; all relevant unknowns remain visible and require source review

additionalSourceExcerpts.purpose: Existing qualified-version, layering and cardinality behavior

anchorIndex: All input graph spec_anchor headings, grouped by source document, with path, line and input source digest; no case-to-anchor correction map
declaredReferenceInventory: Pre-run graph query results grouped by declared target, preserving every case ID and source location; missing anchors marked unresolved, existing anchors not certified as governing
limitations: Historical selectors and line excerpts are pinned to inputCommit, not a live default recipe
Cooperative host instructions are not OS isolation
Packet expansion beyond 8000 estimated tokens must be explicit; never truncate obligations
Baseline and packet share the same brief and verification policy; only packet receives excerpts and index
First-pilot comparison is descriptive because the common brief and scheduling changed
